filesChanged.reason: makeRawRef: coerce pg-bigint strings to numbers — pg driver returns BIGINT as string, causing Number.isInteger() to fail for auto-increment run IDs (20260316000001+)

Add in-flight promise deduplication for resolveRaw() — prevents duplicate fetch requests when React re-renders between loading and resolved states, matching the existing pattern used by resolveRetrievalTelemetry()

Fix 'resolves raw payload lazily and caches it' test — the hook now fires a backfill fetch (context-inspector-events) on mount which the old test did not account for. Updated assertion to filter by URL pattern instead of total call count.
